garment.name: Women's Solid A-line Skirt, Below the Knee (Regular)

source.notes: Regular sizes 0-16 from Lands' End's item-dimensions PDF ('actual garment measurements in inches'); Tall and Plus left out. Rows: Garment waist, Garment hip, Garment length – center back, Garment sweep, all full circumferences (a 28 1/2 in waist on a 25 1/2-26 1/2 in body). Length is taken as centre back from the top of the waistband (the usual skirt definition; the PDF doesn't say more). The hip row gives no height, so it is compared at the fullest hips. Waist 'mid': the PDF gives none; Kohl's listing of this skirt calls it midrise (https://www.kohls.com/product/prd-6642600/womens-lands-end-solid-below-the-knee-a-line-skirt.jsp).

Lands' End's item-dimensions PDF ('actual garment measurements in inches'), sizes S(28-30) to XXL(44-46). Waist is 'Garment waist – relaxed' (an elastic waist: extended 36 3/4-51 3/4 in, so stretch high on the waist); hips are 'Garment seat'; rise is 'Garment front rise'; leg opening is 'Garment bottom opening'. All girths are full circumferences (a 29 in relaxed waist on a 28-30 in body). Back rise (15-18 5/8 in) isn't used. No thigh on the chart.

SanMar's spec sheet (Port Authority is SanMar's own brand). The page prints no unit: inches, by its size chart. Chest measured across the chest 1 in below the armhole, laid flat; body length from the high point of the shoulder to the hem at the back; sleeve from the centre back of the neck, over the shoulder point, to the hem. No shoulder or bicep on the chart. Woven shell (100% polyester; 92/8 poly/spandex in the heathers, so stretch some) bonded to a water-resistant film, microfleece lining (weight mid). Size chart: body chest XS 32–34 to 6XL 61–63 in (men's chests; L317 is the women's cut), so sizing mens. The page has no date. Drawn in a grey.
